{{Top|leg}}
An '''alien quarter''' was a zone on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that contained businesses and facilities that accommodated the needs and desires of non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] travelers. [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan's]] [[Bonadan Alien Quarter|Alien Quarter]] was the most well-known alien quarter in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] due to its size and variety of diversions, in addition to its reputation as a considerably rough area.<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

The planet [[Gand (planet)/Legends|Gand]] also had alien quarters to accommodate the needs of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-breathing visitors. These were located in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and, for most visitors, were the closest they got to [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] society.<ref name="NEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
